# Thingraph GCode Viewer

> Thingraph GCode Viewer is a free browser-based application for previewing slicer GCode toolpaths (.gcode). No desktop install required. Built on the @gcode-viewer/core WebGL SDK (Three.js), with client-side parsing and rendering.

## Application

- [Home](https://gcode.thingraph.site/home): Product overview and entry points
- [GCode Viewer](https://gcode.thingraph.site/gcode-viewer): Upload and preview local GCode files in the browser
- [Examples](https://gcode.thingraph.site/examples): Browse sample GCode and CAD models
- [Support](https://gcode.thingraph.site/google/cad-viewer-support): Help and contact
- [FAQ](https://gcode.thingraph.site/faq/): Static help articles

## FAQ

- [FAQ index](https://gcode.thingraph.site/faq/): Hub for GCode Viewer help articles
- [How to preview GCode in the browser](https://gcode.thingraph.site/faq/how-to-preview-gcode-in-browser.html): Formats, upload, layers, legend, playback
- [Is GCode Viewer safe?](https://gcode.thingraph.site/faq/is-gcode-viewer-safe-are-files-uploaded.html): Client-side preview; files not uploaded to Thingraph servers for viewing

## Supported file formats

- **gcode** — common slicer export

## Features

- Layer scrubbing and step playback
- Legend / color schemes (e.g. by line type)
- GCode text panel synced to the current move
- Local file upload and optional URL load
- View cube, plate, and skybox for orientation
